text:
Situation: Metoprolol succinate extended-release tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. posted a discontinuation on 2026-08-31 citing a business decision to discontinue manufacture. Current stock provides 18.7 to 28.5 days of supply across Corvale East and Corvale General.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include metoprolol succinate as of 2026-10-21. NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (FEI 3003294404) is a registered repack plant; its last inspection was NAI on 2025-03-12. NuCare received a Warning Letter on 2019-09-27 and multiple VAI inspections from 2010 through 2020. Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) is a registered relabel/repack plant; its last inspection was VAI on 2026-07-16. Bryant Ranch had an OAI inspection in 2009, a Warning Letter in 2010, and subsequent VAI inspections through 2026.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. Teva's exit reduces one source but multiple manufacturers remain off the shortage list. Repack plants have acceptable recent inspection classifications.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. (ranked option 1) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Advagen Pharma Limited and Advagen Pharma Ltd as backup sources (ranked options 2 and 3) — requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. and Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. for contract addition (ranked options 4 and 5) — requires buyer, quality assurance, and P&T committee approval.
4. Pharmacy director to monitor daily usage and update inventory projections weekly — requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
